title: Exploring PDP-1 Lisp (1960)
ai_summary:
• Released in 1960, PDP-1 Lisp was a pioneering AI programming language.
• Developed by John McCarthy, it introduced Lisp notation for symbolic computation.
• PDP-1 Lisp laid the foundation for the evolution of AI and functional programming.
student_angle: Learn the history of PDP-1 Lisp to understand the roots of AI and software engineering fundamentals.
